"""Independent saved-array and aggregate check for the contextual join."""
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import json,hashlib
import cv2
import numpy as np
from oil_tracker.adapters.storage.json_recipe_repository import JsonRecipeRepository
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision.artifact_reference import decode_reference,reviewed_edge_mask

root=Path.cwd();out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
load=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text())
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
r=load(out/'result.json');pre=r['preflight']
for name,pin in {**pre['inputs'],**pre['source_pins']}.items():assert sha(root/name)==pin,name
assert sha(out/'preflight.json')==r['preflight_sha256']
old=load(root/'sample/output/s11-foam-upper-gap-20261009-001/brackets.json')
trace=root/next(n for n in pre['inputs'] if n.endswith('debug_trace.jsonl'))
records={a['frame_index']:a for a in map(json.loads,trace.read_text().splitlines())}
recipe=JsonRecipeRepository().load(root/'sample/output/s11-d2-support-comparison-20261009-001/reviewed-f1320-diagnostic-only.oilrecipe')
ref=recipe.glasses[0].geometry.artifact_templates[0].support_reference
_,ri=decode_reference(ref);re=reviewed_edge_mask(ri,ref.review_rect)
rg=cv2.cvtColor(ri['original_roi'],cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
rx,ry,rw,rh=ref.review_rect
totals=Counter()
for case in r['cases']:
    f=case['frame_index'];rec=records[f];totals['cases']+=1
    g=cv2.imread(str(trace.parent/rec['images']['grayscale']),cv2.IMREAD_UNCHANGED)
    a=np.load(root/f'sample/output/s11-foam-upper-gap-20261009-001/capture-f{f}.npz')
    w=np.load(root/f'sample/output/s11-foam-material-sides-20261009-001/measured-f{f}.npz')['warm']
    maps=dict(raw_white=a['raw_white'],clean_white=a['clean_white'],warm=w)
    original=next(c for c in old['cases'] if c['frame_index']==f)
    for c in case['components']:
        totals['components']+=1
        prior=next(p for p in original['components'] if p['component_id']==c['component_id'])
        expected={(col['source_x'],v['radius_px'],i):p for col in prior['columns'] for v in col['views'] for i,p in enumerate(v['gap_brackets'])}
        assert len(expected)==len(c['pairs'])
        observed=set()
        for p in c['pairs']:
            totals['pairs']+=1;x=p['source_x']-543
            key=(p['source_x'],p['radius_px'],p['pair_index'])
            assert key not in observed;observed.add(key)
            assert p['gap']==expected[key]
            raw=p['full_raw_corridor'];ys=np.array([v['source_y']-798 for v in raw])
            assert np.array_equal(ys,np.arange(ys[0],ys[-1]+1))
            assert [v['gray'] for v in raw]==g[ys,x].tolist()
            assert [v['label_id'] for v in raw]==a['labels'][ys,x].tolist()
            for name,arr in maps.items():assert [v[name] for v in raw]==arr[ys,x].tolist()
            for side in ['upper','lower']:
                e=p[side+'_edge'];lo,hi=np.array(e['source_y_range'])-798
                assert e['upper_flank']==next(v for v in raw if v['source_y']==lo+797)
                assert e['lower_flank']==next(v for v in raw if v['source_y']==hi+798)
                values={name:arr[[lo-1,hi],x].tolist() for name,arr in maps.items()}
                for name,(above,below) in values.items():
                    assert e['membership_predicates'][name]==dict(entering=not above and below,crossing=above and below,leaving=above and not below)
                ys2=[y for y in range(lo,hi) if 0<=y<re.shape[0] and rx<=x<rx+rw and ry<=y<ry+rh and ri['effective_mask'][y,x] and not ri['glare_mask'][y,x]]
                assert e['reference']['reviewed_domain_pixels']==len(ys2)
                matches=e['reference']['exact_reviewed_canny_xy']
                assert [v['source_y'] for v in matches]==[y+798 for y in ys2 if re[y,x]]
                for m in matches:
                    y=m['source_y']-798
                    assert m['current_signed_dy']==int(g[y+1,x])-int(g[y-1,x])
                    if m['reference_raw_stencil_available']:
                        assert m['reference_signed_dy']==int(rg[y+1,x])-int(rg[y-1,x])
                totals['edge_records']+=1
        assert observed==set(expected)
        for radius in [4,8]:
            ps=[p for p in c['pairs'] if p['radius_px']==radius]
            cc=dict(pairs=len(ps),columns=len({p['source_x'] for p in ps}))
            if ps:
                for side in ['upper','lower']:
                    for name in maps:
                        for flag in ['entering','crossing','leaving']:
                            cc[f'{side}_{name}_{flag}']=sum(p[side+'_edge']['membership_predicates'][name][flag] for p in ps)
                    cc[f'{side}_reference_domain']=sum(p[side+'_edge']['reference']['reviewed_domain_pixels']>0 for p in ps)
                    cc[f'{side}_reference_hit']=sum(bool(p[side+'_edge']['reference']['exact_reviewed_canny_xy']) for p in ps)
            assert cc==c['counts'][str(radius)]
review=load(out/'review.json')
assert sha(out/'upper-side-review.png')==review['image_sha256']
assert sha(out/'result.json')==review['context_sha256']
for name,pin in {**pre['inputs'],**pre['source_pins']}.items():assert sha(root/name)==pin,name
result=dict(status='PASS',counts=dict(totals),input_count=len(pre['inputs']),production_source_count=len(pre['source_pins']),
            input_preservation=True,all_previous_pairs_preserved=True,raw_arrays_and_aggregate_equality=True,
            review_identity_verified=True,source_changed=False,production_tests_run=False,
            result_sha256=sha(out/'result.json'),script=Path(__file__).read_text())
(out/'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k!='script'})

hypotheses.H1: INSUFFICIENT: white-entry patterns occur on confirmed-rim control
hypotheses.H2: NOT_ADOPTED: chromatic crossing also affects visible-upper-region alternatives
hypotheses.H3: LIMITED: exact Canny XY is not optical correspondence; upper gap is outside reviewed domain

checkpoint.question: Is the feature on the upper (pink) side of the narrow space fixed glass rim/pattern, or another overlapping feature? Existing Foam-upper-surface visibility remains closed; no exact pixel labels requested.
checkpoint.agent_observation: The upper side may be the inner glass rim/pattern, but the blurred narrow dark region does not establish that independently. No current reference covers this upper central region.
checkpoint.limits: All unselected pairs inside one display rectangle, not a fitted contour. A regional reply does not certify every gradient sample or create a reference exclusion mask.
checkpoint.consequence: Distinguish a structure/gap/material adjacency hypothesis from a glass/glass paired-edge counterexample; do not promote gap existence or material side membership alone.

"""Join frozen edge alternatives to actual appearance and reviewed XY evidence.

Read-only saved-raster investigation. No decoder, detector, fitted gate or output
selection. The three hypotheses and input population are written before reads.
"""
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import json
import cv2
import numpy as np

from oil_tracker.adapters.storage.json_recipe_repository import JsonRecipeRepository
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision.artifact_reference import decode_reference, reviewed_edge_mask, reference_preprocessing
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision.artifact_reference_diagnostics import _reference_domain
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision.oil_interface_witness import _extra_channels
from oil_tracker.domain.artifact_reference import geometry_fingerprint

root = Path.cwd()
out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
load = lambda p: json.loads(p.read_text())
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
gapdir = root/'sample/output/s11-foam-upper-gap-20261009-001'
warmdir = root/'sample/output/s11-foam-material-sides-20261009-001'
capture = load(gapdir/'capture.json')
brackets = load(gapdir/'brackets.json')
warmrecord = load(root/'docs/50-diagnostics/s11/2026-10-09-foam-cross-appearance-support.json')
gaprecord = load(root/'docs/50-diagnostics/s11/2026-10-09-foam-upper-gap-representation.json')
inputs = dict(capture['preflight']['inputs'])
sources = dict(capture['preflight']['source_pins'])
for name, pin in capture['outputs'].items():
    inputs[str((gapdir/name).relative_to(root))] = pin
for name, pin in warmrecord['outputs'].items():
    if name.endswith('.npz'):
        inputs[name] = pin
for name, pin in gaprecord['artifacts'].items():
    if name.endswith('/brackets.json'):
        inputs[name] = pin
recipe_path = root/'sample/output/s11-d2-support-comparison-20261009-001/reviewed-f1320-diagnostic-only.oilrecipe'
inputs[str(recipe_path.relative_to(root))] = '0d78fc0637d860ee2802281405462ef0f476e743b9ec3213931449af1c7b2748'
for p in [Path(__file__), gapdir/'capture.json', gapdir/'brackets.json',
          root/'docs/50-diagnostics/s11/2026-10-09-foam-cross-appearance-support.json',
          root/'docs/50-diagnostics/s11/2026-10-09-foam-upper-gap-representation.json']:
    name = str(p.relative_to(root))
    if name in inputs:
        assert sha(p) == inputs[name], name
    else:
        inputs[name] = sha(p)

def verify():
    for name, pin in {**inputs, **sources}.items():
        assert sha(root/name) == pin, name

verify()
pre = dict(schema='s11-gap-context-preflight-v1', base_head='2e5d6accf54b32040a05ceb0793cb07341eced0f',
    frames=[420,450,480,1620,1635,1665,1680], inputs=inputs, source_pins=sources,
    hypotheses={
        'H1':'A rising edge entering raw white membership from an unsupported upper flank may distinguish a material front from internal texture; test against all components including confirmed rim.',
        'H2':'Existing pre-arbitration chromatic membership spanning an edge may expose internal appearance changes; absence is not non-Foam.',
        'H3':'Exact reviewed reference-edge XY intersections are narrower evidence than footprint overlap; outside review scope or no intersection does not prove non-structure.'},
    method='For every saved pair in both original radii retain both plateau intervals, raw immediate flanks and every raw pixel between; join raw/clean white, pre-arbitration warm and label IDs without union. Attach exact reviewed Canny coordinates and current/reference raw signed gradient at those coordinates. No nearest-edge matching, dilation, shift, tolerance, scalar or threshold search.',
    falsification='Identical side predicates on approximate real-Foam and confirmed-rim controls refute a sufficient discriminator. A reviewed-domain miss is unavailable structural evidence, never clean Foam. Reference/current operator or polarity mismatch is explicit.',
    interpretation='Appearance membership is not physical material truth; Canny reference and raw central-difference plateaus are different operators. XY coincidence is not same optical object. All physical decisions remain unresolved.',
    video_decode=False, detector_rerun=False, production_change=False, formal_labels_changed=False)
with (out/'preflight.json').open('x') as f:
    json.dump(pre,f,indent=2); f.write('\n')

recipe = JsonRecipeRepository().load(recipe_path)
glass = recipe.glasses[0]
template = glass.geometry.artifact_templates[0]
reference = template.support_reference
assert reference.snapshot_sha256 == '600c6bc47b2b8f5d6a3ac89e80760c5d432d9739434e9c4d48db78394d1abb80'
status, domain = _reference_domain(reference,glass,template,
    (recipe.reference_frame_width,recipe.reference_frame_height),reference_preprocessing(glass))
assert status == 'available', status
snapshot, refedges, refeligible = domain
_, refimages = decode_reference(reference)
assert int(refedges.sum()) == 125
baseline = JsonRecipeRepository().load(root/'sample/output/s11-local-xy-exclusion-20261009-001/sample4-baseline/recipe.oilrecipe').glasses[0]
assert geometry_fingerprint(glass) == geometry_fingerprint(baseline)
assert reference.correspondence_status(baseline,1080,1234) == 'bound_reference'
refgray = cv2.cvtColor(refimages['original_roi'],cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
refvisible = (refimages['effective_mask']>0)&(refimages['glare_mask']==0)
refvalid = _extra_channels(refgray,refvisible,refimages['effective_mask']>0,np.zeros_like(refgray))['gradient_count']
assert snapshot['crop_origin'] == [543,798]
trace = root/next(n for n in inputs if n.endswith('debug_trace.jsonl'))
records = {r['frame_index']:r for r in map(json.loads,trace.read_text().splitlines())}
cases=[]
for case in brackets['cases']:
    frame=case['frame_index']; rec=records[frame]
    def raster(key):
        p=trace.parent/rec['images'][key]
        assert str(p.relative_to(root)) in inputs
        return cv2.imread(str(p),cv2.IMREAD_UNCHANGED)
    gray=raster('grayscale'); labels=raster('foam_component_labels')
    original=raster('original_roi'); visible=(raster('effective_mask')>0)&(raster('glare_mask')==0)
    assert np.array_equal(gray,cv2.cvtColor(original,cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY))
    raw=np.load(gapdir/f'capture-f{frame}.npz'); warm=np.load(warmdir/f'measured-f{frame}.npz')
    assert np.array_equal(labels,raw['labels']) and np.array_equal(labels,warm['labels'])
    assert np.array_equal(visible,raw['visible']) and np.array_equal(visible,warm['visible'])
    arrays={'raw_white':raw['raw_white'], 'clean_white':raw['clean_white'], 'warm':warm['warm']}
    valid=_extra_channels(gray,visible,raster('effective_mask')>0,np.zeros_like(gray))['gradient_count']
    def sample(x,y):
        assert visible[y,x]
        return dict(source_y=y+798,gray=int(gray[y,x]),label_id=int(labels[y,x]),
                    **{name:bool(a[y,x]) for name,a in arrays.items()})
    def edge(x,interval):
        a,b=[v-798 for v in interval]
        assert valid[a-1:b+1,x].all()
        upper,lower=sample(x,a-1),sample(x,b)
        predicates={name:dict(entering=not upper[name] and lower[name],
                                  crossing=upper[name] and lower[name],
                                  leaving=upper[name] and not lower[name]) for name in arrays}
        eligible_ys=[y for y in range(a,b) if y<refeligible.shape[0] and refeligible[y,x]]
        hits=[y for y in eligible_ys if refedges[y,x]]
        measurements=[]
        for y in hits:
            rv=bool(refvalid[y,x])
            measurements.append(dict(source_y=y+798,
                current_signed_dy=int(gray[y+1,x])-int(gray[y-1,x]),
                reference_signed_dy=(int(refgray[y+1,x])-int(refgray[y-1,x])) if rv else None,
                reference_raw_stencil_available=rv))
        return dict(source_y_range=interval,upper_flank=upper,lower_flank=lower,
            membership_predicates=predicates,
            reference=dict(reviewed_domain_pixels=len(eligible_ys),plateau_pixels=b-a,
                state='OUTSIDE_REVIEWED_DOMAIN' if not eligible_ys else 'FULL_DOMAIN' if len(eligible_ys)==b-a else 'PARTIAL_DOMAIN',
                exact_reviewed_canny_xy=measurements,physical_correspondence='UNRESOLVED'),
            physical_identity='UNRESOLVED')
    comps=[]
    for c in case['components']:
        pairs=[]
        for col in c['columns']:
            x=col['source_x']-543
            for view in col['views']:
                for i,pair in enumerate(view['gap_brackets']):
                    top=pair['upper_edge_source_y_range'];bottom=pair['lower_edge_source_y_range']
                    ys=range(top[0]-798-1,bottom[1]-798+1)
                    pairs.append(dict(source_x=x+543,radius_px=view['radius_px'],pair_index=i,
                        whole_window_fully_observed=view['fully_observed'],gap=pair,
                        upper_edge=edge(x,top),lower_edge=edge(x,bottom),
                        full_raw_corridor=[sample(x,y) for y in ys]))
        counters={}
        for radius in [4,8]:
            ps=[p for p in pairs if p['radius_px']==radius]
            count=Counter(pairs=len(ps),columns=len({p['source_x'] for p in ps}))
            for p in ps:
                for side in ['upper','lower']:
                    e=p[side+'_edge']
                    for name,states in e['membership_predicates'].items():
                        for key,v in states.items():
                            count[f'{side}_{name}_{key}']+=v
                    count[f'{side}_reference_domain']+=e['reference']['reviewed_domain_pixels']>0
                    count[f'{side}_reference_hit']+=bool(e['reference']['exact_reviewed_canny_xy'])
            counters[str(radius)]=dict(count)
        comps.append(dict(component_id=c['component_id'],occupied_columns=len(c['columns']),counts=counters,pairs=pairs))
    cases.append(dict(frame_index=frame,components=comps))
    print(frame,[(c['component_id'],{k:v for k,v in c['counts']['8'].items() if k in ['pairs','columns','lower_raw_white_entering','lower_warm_crossing','lower_reference_domain','lower_reference_hit']}) for c in comps])
verify()
result=dict(schema='s11-gap-context-audit-v1',preflight=pre,preflight_sha256=sha(out/'preflight.json'),
    reference=dict(snapshot_sha256=reference.snapshot_sha256,frame_index=1320,reviewed_edges=125,
                   review_rect=reference.review_rect,crop_origin=snapshot['crop_origin'],context_binding=status),
    cases=cases,inputs_preserved=True,production_source_pins_preserved=True,
    physical_classifier='NOT_ESTABLISHED',selected_fronts=0,script=Path(__file__).read_text())
with (out/'result.json').open('x') as f:
    json.dump(result,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')

"""Independent saved-array and aggregate check for the contextual join."""
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import json,hashlib
import cv2
import numpy as np
from oil_tracker.adapters.storage.json_recipe_repository import JsonRecipeRepository
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision.artifact_reference import decode_reference,reviewed_edge_mask

root=Path.cwd();out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
load=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text())
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
r=load(out/'result.json');pre=r['preflight']
for name,pin in {**pre['inputs'],**pre['source_pins']}.items():assert sha(root/name)==pin,name
assert sha(out/'preflight.json')==r['preflight_sha256']
old=load(root/'sample/output/s11-foam-upper-gap-20261009-001/brackets.json')
trace=root/next(n for n in pre['inputs'] if n.endswith('debug_trace.jsonl'))
records={a['frame_index']:a for a in map(json.loads,trace.read_text().splitlines())}
recipe=JsonRecipeRepository().load(root/'sample/output/s11-d2-support-comparison-20261009-001/reviewed-f1320-diagnostic-only.oilrecipe')
ref=recipe.glasses[0].geometry.artifact_templates[0].support_reference
_,ri=decode_reference(ref);re=reviewed_edge_mask(ri,ref.review_rect)
rg=cv2.cvtColor(ri['original_roi'],cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
rx,ry,rw,rh=ref.review_rect
totals=Counter()
for case in r['cases']:
    f=case['frame_index'];rec=records[f];totals['cases']+=1
    g=cv2.imread(str(trace.parent/rec['images']['grayscale']),cv2.IMREAD_UNCHANGED)
    a=np.load(root/f'sample/output/s11-foam-upper-gap-20261009-001/capture-f{f}.npz')
    w=np.load(root/f'sample/output/s11-foam-material-sides-20261009-001/measured-f{f}.npz')['warm']
    maps=dict(raw_white=a['raw_white'],clean_white=a['clean_white'],warm=w)
    original=next(c for c in old['cases'] if c['frame_index']==f)
    for c in case['components']:
        totals['components']+=1
        prior=next(p for p in original['components'] if p['component_id']==c['component_id'])
        expected={(col['source_x'],v['radius_px'],i):p for col in prior['columns'] for v in col['views'] for i,p in enumerate(v['gap_brackets'])}
        assert len(expected)==len(c['pairs'])
        observed=set()
        for p in c['pairs']:
            totals['pairs']+=1;x=p['source_x']-543
            key=(p['source_x'],p['radius_px'],p['pair_index'])
            assert key not in observed;observed.add(key)
            assert p['gap']==expected[key]
            raw=p['full_raw_corridor'];ys=np.array([v['source_y']-798 for v in raw])
            assert np.array_equal(ys,np.arange(ys[0],ys[-1]+1))
            assert [v['gray'] for v in raw]==g[ys,x].tolist()
            assert [v['label_id'] for v in raw]==a['labels'][ys,x].tolist()
            for name,arr in maps.items():assert [v[name] for v in raw]==arr[ys,x].tolist()
            for side in ['upper','lower']:
                e=p[side+'_edge'];lo,hi=np.array(e['source_y_range'])-798
                assert e['upper_flank']==next(v for v in raw if v['source_y']==lo+797)
                assert e['lower_flank']==next(v for v in raw if v['source_y']==hi+798)
                values={name:arr[[lo-1,hi],x].tolist() for name,arr in maps.items()}
                for name,(above,below) in values.items():
                    assert e['membership_predicates'][name]==dict(entering=not above and below,crossing=above and below,leaving=above and not below)
                ys2=[y for y in range(lo,hi) if 0<=y<re.shape[0] and rx<=x<rx+rw and ry<=y<ry+rh and ri['effective_mask'][y,x] and not ri['glare_mask'][y,x]]
                assert e['reference']['reviewed_domain_pixels']==len(ys2)
                matches=e['reference']['exact_reviewed_canny_xy']
                assert [v['source_y'] for v in matches]==[y+798 for y in ys2 if re[y,x]]
                for m in matches:
                    y=m['source_y']-798
                    assert m['current_signed_dy']==int(g[y+1,x])-int(g[y-1,x])
                    if m['reference_raw_stencil_available']:
                        assert m['reference_signed_dy']==int(rg[y+1,x])-int(rg[y-1,x])
                totals['edge_records']+=1
        assert observed==set(expected)
        for radius in [4,8]:
            ps=[p for p in c['pairs'] if p['radius_px']==radius]
            cc=dict(pairs=len(ps),columns=len({p['source_x'] for p in ps}))
            if ps:
                for side in ['upper','lower']:
                    for name in maps:
                        for flag in ['entering','crossing','leaving']:
                            cc[f'{side}_{name}_{flag}']=sum(p[side+'_edge']['membership_predicates'][name][flag] for p in ps)
                    cc[f'{side}_reference_domain']=sum(p[side+'_edge']['reference']['reviewed_domain_pixels']>0 for p in ps)
                    cc[f'{side}_reference_hit']=sum(bool(p[side+'_edge']['reference']['exact_reviewed_canny_xy']) for p in ps)
            assert cc==c['counts'][str(radius)]
review=load(out/'review.json')
assert sha(out/'upper-side-review.png')==review['image_sha256']
assert sha(out/'result.json')==review['context_sha256']
for name,pin in {**pre['inputs'],**pre['source_pins']}.items():assert sha(root/name)==pin,name
result=dict(status='PASS',counts=dict(totals),input_count=len(pre['inputs']),production_source_count=len(pre['source_pins']),
            input_preservation=True,all_previous_pairs_preserved=True,raw_arrays_and_aggregate_equality=True,
            review_identity_verified=True,source_changed=False,production_tests_run=False,
            result_sha256=sha(out/'result.json'),script=Path(__file__).read_text())
(out/'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k!='script'})

limitations: Same exposed development frames; no held-out efficacy.
All observations including both radii are retained; duplicates are not independent evidence.
Support membership and raw gradient signs are not material identity.
Reference Canny and current raw gradient use distinct operators; no nearest/dilated/motion correspondence.
Regional upper-side question cannot authorize an exact exclusion mask or physical selector.
